units.evidence: Complete official three-page business inventory identifies Busch School of Business and formal Technology and Operations Management major, substantive academic Ops programme beyond one generic core course.

decisions.reason: Generic imported Business label reconciled to current official Busch School of Business, which explicitly offers Technology and Operations Management major.

sources.note: Entire current College of Engineering Physics and Computing graduate programme inventory read. Engineering Management explicitly MS only; actual PhDs include Applied Physics/Nanotechnology, Biomedical, Civil, CS, Electrical, Environmental, Mechanical and Physics. Degree titles not themselves proof of qualifying Operations fields.

Entire Civil Engineering PhD overview/details/curriculum read. Actual PhD with original dissertation/defence, Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, current five formal fields including Transportation and Systems Engineering and Construction Engineering and Management. Detailed substantive Ops/OR scope not established from field names alone; not added as qualifying route. Courses and Electives control did not expose usable hyperlink in inspected links; no course-detail claims.

All three unfiltered business programme pages individually navigated and read, final page3 of3. Exact Busch School of Business; formal Technology and Operations Management undergraduate major explicitly listed. Graduate degrees MBA and Ecclesial Administration Management MS, plus certificates; no business doctoral degree in complete business list.

limitations: Actual Civil Engineering PhD Transportation and Systems Engineering field is a discovery lead; detailed Ops/OR/logistics scope not yet established.
Other current engineering doctoral fields remain unexamined in detail; no absence inferred from general systems/manufacturing titles.
Technology and Operations Management major is undergraduate, not separate department or PhD.
